Hannah / Marissa —

Short answer: Azure private offers typically need the following to complete entitlement provisioning on the marketplace side:

1) Signed commercial docs (PO + SOW) — yes, that covers the commercial terms.
2) Marketplace entitlement form (we file through Partner Center) — required when the buyer wants a private offer with listing restrictions (they usually want this so their billing maps correctly).
3) Merchant/legal entity mapping — critical for invoice/payment routing and for revenue split.

I'll open the Partner Center entitlement submission once we have: (a) final SOW, (b) merchant legal name + tax ID, (c) contact for marketplace onboarding. The entitlement form is mostly administrative but takes 2-3 business days to process on Azure side.

I'll also attach standard guidance for SOC2 and DPA packaging.

Jonas
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PartnerCenter_entitlement_checklist.pdf (guidance)
